'\u003e'\n                             : limit == fast ? '='\n                                             : '\u003c'),\n                            fast);\n\n  // Step 2: Laminar Search (Override to FALSE)\n  // Condition: fast \u003c 0.75 * slow AND lbd_var_ema \u003c 1.0\n  bool laminar = (fast \u003c 0.75 * slow) && (lbd_var_ema \u003c 1.0);\n\n  if (standard_restart) {\n      if (laminar) {\n          if (laminar_skips \u003c 5) {\n              laminar_skips++;\n              kissat_very_verbose (solver, \n                  \"Laminar override: skipping restart (fast=%.2f, var=%.2f, skips=%d)\", \n                  fast, lbd_var_ema, laminar_skips);\n              return false; // OVERRIDE: Skip restart\n          }\n      }\n      // If we proceed to restart, reset skips\n      laminar_skips = 0;\n      return true;\n  }\n\n  // Step 3: Turbulent Search (Override to TRUE)\n  // Condition: fast \u003e 1.05 * slow AND lbd_var_ema \u003e (0.2 * slow)\n  bool turbulent = (fast \u003e 1.05 * slow) && (lbd_var_ema \u003e (0.2 * slow));\n\n  if (!standard_restart && turbulent) {\n      kissat_very_verbose (solver, \n          \"Turbulent override: forcing restart (fast=%.2f, slow=%.2f, var=%.2f)\", \n          fast, slow, lbd_var_ema);\n      laminar_skips = 0;\n      return true; // OVERRIDE: Force restart\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","usageMetadata":{"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":6195}],"promptTokenCount":6195,"totalTokenCount":17372,"thoughtsTokenCount":10275,"candidatesTokenCount":902},"responseId":"FtWKadCtHObYqtsPqJCv8QY"},"key":"req-0001"}
